Paycheck Comparison

Compare two job offers: salary, bonus, benefits value, PTO and estimated tax.

Offer A

Offer B

For information only — not financial advice. Tax is a rough estimate; cost of living is not included.

📖 How to use

  1. Fill in Offer A: salary, bonus, benefits, PTO days, and estimated tax rate.
  2. Fill in Offer B the same way.
  3. Compare the side-by-side table of cash, benefits, and total value.
  4. Read the verdict showing which offer has the higher estimated total value.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is PTO valued?

Each PTO day is valued at salary divided by 260 working days, a common approximation.

What tax rate should I enter?

Enter your estimated effective tax rate on cash compensation. It is only an estimate; actual tax depends on your full situation.

Does it include cost of living?

No. It compares compensation only. A lower offer in a cheaper city can still leave you better off.
